purpose: Minimal package needed to run the hidden-data forecast robustness experiment without exposing or mixing locked-test data.

metadata_required.feature_names: one unique name per feature column

npz_required_arrays.values: float [rows, features]; unobserved cells may be NaN
npz_required_arrays.roles: string [rows], exactly fit/calibration/threshold/score in chronological blocks
npz_required_arrays.unit_ids: nonempty episode/unit id [rows]; one role per unit

experiment_rule: Artificial missingness may be introduced only into cells that are genuinely observed, nonstructural and in the train-only score role. The reference model, calibration and threshold are frozen before the artificial outage is applied.
physics_rule: Physics is not generated from this tabular package. A physics arm requires separately validated magnetic-map geometry and a causal map-to-feature transformation. This prevents a tabular missing value from being relabelled as physics without a physical state behind it.
claim_boundary: This package contract does not establish forecast improvement, physics-reconstruction benefit, operational readiness, company superiority, economic savings, breakthrough or award outcome.
